steps.title: Initialize Goofball Machine Project
steps.description: Create the core folder structure and configuration for the Goofball Machine application.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Configure the Gradle settings using Java 17 and AGP 8.3.2 in compatibility with Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Request Permissions and Define Manifest
steps.description: Configure the AndroidManifest.xml with appropriate launch action and standard vibration permission.

steps.title: Design the Main Layout UI
steps.description: Create a fully functional scrollable dashboard container containing cards for the Excuse Generator, Dad Jokes, Drama Button, and Boss Panic Mode.

steps.title: Create Excuse Generator Templates
steps.description: Program arrays of subjects, verbs, and objects inside MainActivity to create chaotic, funny excuse generator combinations.

steps.title: Write Joke Database
steps.description: Code a clean storage list of classic silly dad jokes directly into the Java controller.

steps.title: Implement Haptic Feedback and Drama Shake
steps.description: Implement standard Android Vibrator actions and programmatic TranslateAnimation to make the screen shake dramatically on user prompt.

steps.title: Program Tone Sound Generation
steps.description: Use standard Android ToneGenerator to generate dramatic retro audio effects on click.

steps.title: Develop Boss Panic Mode Overlay
steps.description: Create full screen layout switcher to instantly toggle a fake extremely boring spreadsheet view when the boss approaches.

steps.title: Integrate Component Click Listeners
steps.description: Connect UI buttons to their specific Java click handlers using Java 8 compatible traditional inner classes.

steps.title: Run Sanity Checks and Manifest Validations
steps.description: Verify XML namespaces and class packages to avoid building bottlenecks.

steps.title: Building Goofball Machine
steps.description: Compile the ultimate Android interactive humor app using Java 17 toolchain.
